type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. Names the role, not the vendor.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: The PUBLISH instant — when this message went out, ISO-8601 UTC. A republish has the same content and a new ts.

target.description: The switcher this message addresses — the <target> routing segment: the switcher's configured name, 'main' by default, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Required on every switcher message.

SwitcherCurrentTally.description: Ask one switcher for its tally. Envelope-only — the reply is a SwitcherTallyChanged, identical to the broadcast.
